findings.summary: Without the beforeRun gate the pre-execution aborted branch does nothing observable (equivalent mutant), because Shell already honors a pre-aborted signal. It was the gate's companion check. It predates this unit and is not on the Acceptance 3 removal list, so it is not a REV-7 blocker; trimming it is optional.

Reopen failure now goes through transition(). When openActive rejects, runtime.current() is null (active is set only on success, playground-app-runtime.ts:123), so rebindAfterPlaygroundTransitionFailure (playground-app.tsx:645) rethrows and the initialize catch still runs flashError + openLauncher. projectBusy is cleared in finally, and disposeBound with nothing bound only calls bindSession(undefined). By reading this matches BASE, but no committed test drives a failing plain-URL reopen (the Decisions line 'indicator yields to the existing error surface' is untraced). Hardening option: a case where openActive rejects that asserts the error toast, the launcher, and that the pill does not stay in switching.
